svg.title: Measure One Cohort through Payable Affiliate Outcomes
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-organic-to-payable-affiliate-cohort; chart type: funnel; title: Measure One Cohort through Payable Affiliate Outcomes; subtitle: 100,000 eligible organic sessions narrow to 530 payable sessions.; chapter number: 6; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Illustrative cohort, not observed performance or an annual projection. Every downstream count is a subset of the original 100,000 sessions, counted once per stage. Use permitted attribution records and a stated 60-day reconciliation window. Assume exactly one $20 approved commission per payable session.; caption: The cohort earns $10,600 in affiliate revenue: 530 multiplied by $20. Merchant order value is excluded. Advertising and sponsorship earnings are outside this conversion funnel.; stages: label: Organic entry sessions; value: 100,000 sessions establish the original cohort; numeric value: 100000.0; detail: Freeze eligible organic landing sessions for the cohort period. Exclude internal traffic and bot traffic; document measurement exclusions instead of treating them as conversions.; label: Commercial-content readers; value: 40,000 sessions; 40% of entry cohort; numeric value: 40000.0; detail: Count sessions reaching at least one relevant comparison or product-selection page. Multiple page views within the same session do not enlarge this stage.; label: Affiliate outbound sessions; value: 12,000 sessions; 30% of commercial readers; numeric value: 12000.0; detail: Count sessions with at least one disclosed affiliate outbound event. Preserve campaign and content identifiers without transmitting unnecessary personal information.; label: Attributed purchase sessions; value: 600 sessions; 5% of outbound sessions; numeric value: 600.0; detail: Match merchant-reported purchase events back to eligible outbound sessions. Deduplicate purchases within each session and retain pending status during returns review.; label: Payable purchase sessions; value: 530 sessions; 88.33% of purchase sessions; numeric value: 530.0; detail: Remove 70 sessions whose purchases were reversed or disallowed. Final conversion is 0.53% of the original cohort; reconcile $10,600 to approved commission statements.

text.title: Measure One Cohort through Payable Affiliate Outcomes
text.tspan: Measure One Cohort through Payable Affiliate Outcomes

circle.title: label: Organic entry sessions; value: 100,000 sessions establish the original cohort; numeric value: 100000.0; detail: Freeze eligible organic landing sessions for the cohort period. Exclude internal traffic and bot traffic; document measurement exclusions instead of treating them as conversions.

label: Commercial-content readers; value: 40,000 sessions; 40% of entry cohort; numeric value: 40000.0; detail: Count sessions reaching at least one relevant comparison or product-selection page. Multiple page views within the same session do not enlarge this stage.

label: Affiliate outbound sessions; value: 12,000 sessions; 30% of commercial readers; numeric value: 12000.0; detail: Count sessions with at least one disclosed affiliate outbound event. Preserve campaign and content identifiers without transmitting unnecessary personal information.

label: Attributed purchase sessions; value: 600 sessions; 5% of outbound sessions; numeric value: 600.0; detail: Match merchant-reported purchase events back to eligible outbound sessions. Deduplicate purchases within each session and retain pending status during returns review.

label: Payable purchase sessions; value: 530 sessions; 88.33% of purchase sessions; numeric value: 530.0; detail: Remove 70 sessions whose purchases were reversed or disallowed. Final conversion is 0.53% of the original cohort; reconcile $10,600 to approved commission statements.

text.title: Assumptions: Illustrative cohort, not observed performance or an annual projection. Every downstream count is a subset of the original 100,000 sessions, counted once per stage. Use permitted attribution records and a stated 60-day reconciliation window. Assume exactly one $20 approved commission per payable session.
text.tspan: Assumptions: Illustrative cohort, not observed performance or an annual projection. Every downstream count is a subset of the
